title: Aliased model, evaluator, context and operation names compile and run as their installed entries
summary: compileHarness compares a profile's model with the host's and its contracts' model lists by installed name. A record may name a model by a name the alias table renames, and a host or contract may list such a name; an alias a list relies on is recorded as a record's is, so compiledAliases still rebuilds the harness. An operation record and its binding may name two generations of one handler, such as a workspace's own binding that still names captured-source-read-v1. A compiled profile stores each check and context under the installed name the compilation pins, so executionManifest and the runner use the pinned evaluator and context, and a host's evaluate receives the installed evaluator name. executionManifest also resolves a check stored under a renamed name through the harness's own alias table, and refuses an evaluator the harness does not pin.
